summary: Solid deliverable following Python/YAML best practices. Workflow correctly uses least-privilege permissions, pinned action refs (v4), and sensible triggers. artifact_cleanup.py exhibits strong practices: frozen dataclasses prevent mutation bugs, specific exception handling (FileNotFoundError, JSONDecodeError), pluggable NullDeleter for testability, and excellent docstrings explaining the three-rule policy engine. Type hints use Python 3.10+ union syntax correctly. run_act_tests.py is comprehensive but verbose—the case definitions with hand-derived expected values are intentionally explicit for exact assertions, though this creates brittle test fixtures if output format drifts. No dead code or concerning duplication. Minor: test expectations require manual curation; consider adding assertions about format stability.
